name: 6:06 PM
desc:
Trapped in a maze of endless, winning smiles, you’re caught in a cruel cycle of forced cheerfulness. Every turn leads you deeper into this hellish labyrinth, where each smile feels more agonizing than the last. With every step, you grow more desperate to escape, but the path to freedom is elusive, and the smiles never fade.

EPILEPSY AND VOLUME WARNING

This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy, as it contains bright colors and flashing lights. Play at your own risk, seek medical attention if you experience dizziness, nausea, or blackouts.
